login.title: Log in to FleetCore
login.description: Enter your email and password to access your fleet.
login.linkError: That link is invalid or has expired. Log in, or request a new password reset link.

signup.title: Create your FleetCore account
signup.description: You'll be the admin of your company's fleet.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account and company.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a link to reset your password. Open the link in this browser.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.description: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

signedIn.title: You're already signed in
signedIn.description: Change your password in Settings. You'll need your current password.

passwordErrors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
passwordErrors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
passwordErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
